subject.title: [Feature]: Add JSON-RPC bindings for language-agnostic plugins

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked JSON-RPC plugin manifest/SDK ABI as a supported protocol v1, narrow or gate it before release, or keep this issue as a design record only?
rationale: Current main does not implement the feature, and the open PR would add a public plugin-author child-process ABI that affects SDK compatibility and security/support boundaries.

options.title: Review And Land Protocol V1
options.body: Accept the linked PR direction after owner review of the manifest field, payload shapes, permission model, timeout/lifecycle behavior, docs, and export baseline.

options.title: Narrow Or Gate The ABI
options.body: Keep the PR open but reduce the supported registration/host-call surface or mark it experimental/internal before release.

options.title: Keep As Design Record
options.body: Do not accept the current implementation yet; leave this issue open until maintainers define the desired language-neutral plugin boundary.

recommendation.title: Review And Land Protocol V1
recommendation.body: Accept the linked PR direction after owner review of the manifest field, payload shapes, permission model, timeout/lifecycle behavior, docs, and export baseline.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history signal for public plugin SDK docs and boundary review across the files this feature would formalize.
